Results.ReviewText:
I have made a few really nice dinners overall so am happy with the purchase. I have used many Webers in the past, including gas ones. I respect the quality and craftsmanship.

My reason for four stars is that the lid doesn’t fit easily on the grill - it is too tight and you have to push down to put it in right. If you don’t pay attention, it falls. With the millions of lids Weber has made over the years, I’m surprised that this isn’t working! On other ones it fits like a glove.

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill to avoid the grease mess and clean up issues associated with a gas grill. The kettle grill cooks my food perfectly because it reaches temperatures the gas grill could only hope to reach. Waiting for the charcoal to fire up is a non-issue, light them in a chimney and by the time I gather up the food, the coals are ready.  When it has cooled down, usually overnight, it's super simple to toss the ashes.
Results.Title: So Simple

Results.ReviewText: From indirect, direct or smocking exemplar product.
Results.Title: Cooking Methods

Results.ReviewText: When I was in HS and College, my dad had a Weber Grill that I would always use. I used to BBQ all of the time. That stopped when I got married and started a family due to always working or taking care of the boys. It was never enough. I finally decided to buy one after I kept seeing them at Academy or online. Man… it was definitely worth the first BBQ I have had in years! Ever since then, I have been BBQing every weekend since. It has been great because I can cook food so fast. Plus, it has all the great features like the lid hook so I can put the lid on the side of the pot instead on the ground. My family is very happy that I started BBQing again! Thank you Weber!
Results.Title: Best Grill Period

Results.ReviewText: I bought this about 6 weeks ago, where I complained about poor quality pieces. The kettle itself is as good as ever, just some of the other parts including the legs and grill grate were substandard, I was displeased with that and gave a poor review. Giovanna from Weber contacted me and asked how they could fix the issues. They sent me the proper replacement grill grate and a new set of legs.  The unit is now as it is supposed to be and as I have become accustomed to. This is being used several times a week and suspect will last for several years.
Results.Title: With upgrades the perfect grilling machine

741001.Description: Stay true to the modern version of the kettle that started it all—the Original Kettle®, invented by Weber’s founder, and loved around the world. Its ultra-durable, porcelain-enameled lid and bowl retain heat, while the dampers easily adjust for precise temperature control. With a One-Touch™ cleaning system for easy cleanup after a long day of grilling, the Original Kettle® will always be the grill built for everyone.•	 Holds up to 13 burgers made with a Weber burger press•	 One-Touch™ cleaning system provides hassle-free ash cleanup•	 Porcelain-enameled lid and bowl retain heat, and won’t rust or peel•	 Use the lid hook to avoid placing the lid on the ground while grilling•	 Dampers allow you to easily control the temperature inside your grill•	 Durable plated steel cooking grate retains heat and is easy to clean
